[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.73x): Below the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Lack of directional conviction due to RSI entering oversold and subdued volume, maintaining conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
